cases.why: the clock half of the lock is gone, so an ungraded game stays open through kickoff and into the fourth quarter. Every card still looks like a card and every pick still saves, which is the whole problem: a pick made with the score on the screen is indistinguishable from one made on Saturday.
a graded game is no longer locked on its own account, so a wrong kickoff field or a visitor's wrong clock reopens a game whose result is already on the page.

the tap handler stops asking whether the game has kicked off. The buttons are still disabled on a fresh render, so a quick check looks fine; what reopens is a page left open across a kickoff, whose buttons stay live until something repaints them.
Undo writes the previous pick back without checking the clock, so tapping a pick seconds before kickoff and Undo seconds after is a late change the lock never saw.

a new pick is saved without the time it was made. Nothing on the card changes; the pick just quietly never counts once its game is graded, and the scoreboard's left-out count grows for a reason the visitor did nothing to cause.
a day's grace after kickoff, so a pick made during the game -- or right after it -- is counted as if it had been made in time. The exploit this stage exists to close, reopened by one comparison.
the tally stops leaving out picks with no time, so everything saved before this change -- including every winner written in after the results -- is back in the race.

the kickoff instant is built from the Eastern fields as if they were the visitor's local time. In New York nothing changes; in Los Angeles every game locks three hours late, and nobody testing from the east coast can see it.

cases.why: a fixed UTC-4. Right until the first Sunday of November, then every lock is an hour late for the rest of the season and the playoffs.

an untimed pick on a game that has already kicked off is stamped with now. Now is after kickoff, so it would read as late rather than untimed -- but the worse half is that the rule 'now proves before kickoff' is applied where it proves nothing.
